items.information:
# The competition is cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. Please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MapleRidge2020#14251-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

For events/rounds **after lunch**, please be present and ready to compete **at least 30 minutes before your event(s)**, in case we are ahead of schedule.

We might add a second round of megaminx, if we are ahead of schedule.

venue.name: B.D. Somani International School 625, G.D. Somani Marg, Ganesh Murti Nagar, Cuffe Parade, Mumbai, Maharashtra

items.information:
# The competition has been cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak.

**How to reach the venue:**
Landmark- President hotel
From the President hotel signal, turn towards the hotel, into the road (could be left or right depending from where you're coming) Go straight in that road, and take a U-turn at the end. Keep going, and you will see the school logo on a wall. There are 3 gates, you can enter from any one, and after that enter the building from the right most gate (facing the building) 
In the school, go straight, and take a left before the field. Go straight again, and take a left before the basketball court. You will see 2 lifts, take any to the fifth floor, or you can take the stairs.

items.name: Boise Spring 2020
items.information:
# This competition has been cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak.

Please make sure you know all of the WCA regulations.

If you haven't attended a competition before or even would just like a refresher on how they work, please show up for the competitor tutorial at 8:30am.

It is also recommended to watch the [tutorial video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) about how WCA competitions work.

If you are in the Boise area, please consider joining the [Boise Speedcubing Club](https://www.facebook.com/boisespeedcubing/) to meet other members of the community and influence future competitions!
